title: Behavioral-first Hosted Endpoint PRD and Staged Launch Checklist for Chat/Gen/Embed/Rerank
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This PRD defines a behavioral-first product and launch plan for a unified hosted inference surface that supports chat (stateful), generative completions, embeddings, and rerank. The goal is to ship a single, consistent endpoint surface and operational checklist that guarantees predictable behavioral contracts (response shape, function/tool-calling stability, safety heuristics) while meeting latency and cost SLOs across tiers. This ticket scopes the product decisions, acceptance criteria, rollout strategy, and cross-team dependencies required to go live with the feature set in release hosted-api-2026.04.
scope_in_scope: Single API surface and parameter mapping for: chat (stateful), completions, embeddings, rerank
Behavioral contracts for default safety and hallucination mitigations (prompt prefixes, reply filters)
Per-model and per-tenant SLO targets and alerting (p50/p95 latency, error rate, quality regressions)
Staged rollout with progressive quality gates and canary traffic slicing
Acceptance harness: synthetic and production-sampled prompt suites plus automated eval metrics
scope_out_of_scope: Dedicated capacity reservation UI changes (handled in Dedicated roadmap)
On-prem private control plane packaging and air-gapped install scripts
Deep model retraining or new model onboarding (model selection only; onboarding is separate)
requirements: API contract: stable request/response JSON with explicit version header and backward-compatible field deprecations
Backwards-compatible defaults for rate limits and tokenization to avoid client regressions
Streaming and non-streaming parity for chat and completions with identical partial-message semantics
Embedding endpoint guarantees identical vector dimension and normalization behavior across models in same family
Rerank contract: deterministic score normalization and tie-breaking documented
Behavioral test harness that runs nightly: safety checks, jailbreak heuristics, benchmark prompts, and quality thresholds
Operational telemetry: per-request model variant, route, tenant, tokens, latency, and eval-score tags
acceptance_criteria: API contract published in Confluence and SDKs updated with migration notes
Behavioral test suite passing: safety false-positive <= 0.8% and safety false-negative <= 1.5% on curated test set
Latency SLO: p95 <= 350ms for gen small models and p95 <= 1200ms for long-context workloads on hosted tier
Error rate SLO: platform error rate < 0.5% sustained during 24h synthetic traffic
Cost regression check: end-to-end per-1000-token cost change <= +5% for default profile compared to baseline
Rollout runbook validated with one successful canary promotion without behavioral regressions
SDK language bindings (Python, Node) smoke tests green and CI coverage updated
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal dogfood with Redwood internal tenants + synthetic load (2 days)
Phase 1: Beta customers opt-in (5–10% traffic) with daily quality reviews
Phase 2: Staged expansion by region and tenant size with automated rollback triggers
Phase 3: Full public launch after 2 weeks of stable metrics and post-launch review
monitoring_slos: p50/p95 latency per route/model family per-region (dashboards created)
Request success rate per-route >= 99.5% (alerts if 5min window drops)
Quality regression alert: automated eval score drop > 1.5% on baseline prompt set
Telemetry retention: request-level traces for 14 days, aggregate metrics 90 days
qa_plan: Unit + integration tests for API surface and SDKs
Behavioral harness: nightly runs with result diffs and artifact storage
Chaos inference test: simulate kernel fallback and ensure graceful degrade policy triggers
Manual UX/Console checks: rollout UI, per-tenant SLO panels, and cost-breakdown links
Customer acceptance: run 3 customer-specific prompt sets and sign-off from solutions engineer
migration_plan: Compatibility shim for legacy endpoint keys for 90 days
SDK migration guide with examples and automated code snippets
Automatic 30-day deprecation notice for tenants using legacy fields
Telemetry mapping to correlate old and new route names for historical dashboards
rollback_plan: Automatic rollback on behavioral regression: if nightly eval drop > 2.5% or safety FN > 2%
Manual immediate rollback criteria: customer-reported critical failure affecting >2 tenants
Fallback to previous model-variant or route with warm KV cache prewarmed for fast recovery
